Employee Salary Calculator (Method Overloading)

Problem Statement:
Write a program to demonstrate method overloading by creating a class Employee with overloaded methods calculateSalary().

One method should accept base salary only.

Another should accept base salary and bonus.

Another should accept base salary, bonus, and deductions.

Description:
Use method overloading to calculate salary with different parameters.

Input Format:

First line: base salary

Second line: bonus (optional)

Third line: deductions (optional)

Output Format:
Final calculated salary
